messages:
Iris (PM): Need quick review: model catalog compare table — customers want pinging to be obvious and keyboard-friendly; perf badges must be readable by screen readers. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mnop3456/compare-ux
Marco (Design): Agree. Move pin left of name and add a small 'Pinned' label when active. Also add a 4px left accent on the row so it's visible at a glance.
Sam (Frontend): Will change DOM order so pin is before title for natural tab order. Plan: checkbox -> pin -> title -> badges -> actions. Pin will be tabindex=0, role="button", aria-pressed toggled.
Lily (A11y): For badges, prefer a grouped hidden summary per row (aria-describedby) reading: "p50 10ms, p95 120ms, p99 310ms". Individual chips keep aria-labels for focus. Use aria-live="polite" for pin toasts.
Dan (QA): Test cases: SR reads perf summary, pin/unpin announced, focus order matches spec, shortcut scoped to table works. I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA when staging is up.
Iris (PM): Shortcut: 'p' to toggle pin on focused row. Show tooltip "Press P to pin" and set aria-keyshortcuts="p". Make live region messages descriptive for SRs, visual toast short.
Marco (Design): Contrast: badge text too light at 12px. Options: darker text or bolder weight. I'll update artboard with icon variants.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation notes: single sr-only announcer with debounce to avoid repeated reads. Ensure Space key calls preventDefault.
Lily (A11y): Also ensure pinned state not conveyed by color only — icon + label required. Use clear aria-labels like "Pin model Foo v2.1".
Iris (PM): Acceptance criteria: pin focusable left of title; pin state icon+label not color-only; perf metrics announced via aria-describedby; 'p' shortcut scoped to table; toasts announced via aria-live and deduped; badge contrast meets AA or uses bolder text. Tagging owners: @Marco design, @Sam frontend, @Lily a11y, @Dan qa.
Sam (Frontend): Will open a WIP PR with DOM reorder and announcer region. ETA: tomorrow morning staging.
Marco (Design): I'll push updated figma components today.
Lily (A11y): I'll prepare quick SR scripts to validate after deploy.
Dan (QA): Scheduling a 20m check after staging build.
Iris (PM): Thanks all 44d Closing thread. Ping me if anything blocks.
